title: UI: Fix capture options Tab key ordering
description:
Current field ordering when using Tab key in the **Capture Options - Output** page is "random", this tries to order the fields sequentially.

First time I ever edited those `.ui` files, so please review if something else would be needed as well. I just reordered the complete layout-level `item` elements of the fields according to row and column values, maybe not evident from the diff output. This seemed to work though.

Testing: Click **Create a new file automatically...**, and then press Tab key to proceed to next fields.

![image](/uploads/89117a3eec2de0f72894ba6cf999802d/image.png)
